facts_claimed: Somnath Jyotirling is located in Prabhas Patan, Gujarat, on the coast of the Arabian Sea.
According to mythology, King Daksha's 27 daughters were married to Chandra Dev (the Moon God).
Chandra Dev was partial to his wife Rohini, leading to a curse from King Daksha.
The curse caused the moon to wane, leading to darkness in the world.
Chandra Dev performed penance to Lord Shiva, who then granted him the boon of waxing and waning, and appeared as Somnath.
